product: Roadshock 8 in. Spot/Flood Combo LED Light Bar
summary: Combo beam pattern chart and specs from the Roadshock 8 in. light bar box (SKU 64324): 110 lx at 30 ft, 1 lx at 350 ft, 0.25 lx at 600 ft.
body: This is the beam pattern chart printed on the retail box of the Harbor Freight Roadshock 8 in. Spot/Flood Combo LED Light Bar, item 64324. Harbor Freight's product page lists the lumens and the 696 ft. range, but it doesn't show this chart or any lux readings.

The chart is a top-down view of the beam. The light levels printed along the top line up with the distances printed along the bottom: 110 lx at 30 ft, 1 lx at 350 ft, and 0.25 lx at 600 ft. The side scale runs 90 ft to each side of center.
The box also lists lumens, beam distance, color temperature, voltage, and wattage (below). Those match the product page.
transcription:
COMBO BEAM PATTERN
110 lx      1 lx      0.25 lx
30ft        350ft     600ft
(side scale: 90ft 60ft 30ft 0ft 30ft 60ft 90ft)

SPECIFICATIONS
Lumens: 1440
Beam Distance: 696 ft.
Color Temperature: 6250K
DC Volts: 12/24
Wattage: 23
FOR OFF-ROAD USE ONLY

ITEM 64324
transcription_notes: A small round sticker unrelated to the product was blurred in the photo.
